assumptions.choice: Daily RSI(14) is computed manually by aggregating end-of-day closes from the 5-minute feed (the last bar of each session), using a hand-rolled Wilder RSI, since the harness supplies only a single 5-minute PandasData feed and no daily-resampled feed can be constructed inside the Strategy.
assumptions.reason: The environment fixes cerebro setup and provides one 5m data feed; a true daily-timeframe indicator is not available, so this is the closest literal reading of 'daily RSI(14)'.

assumptions.choice: Wilder's smoothed RSI: first average gain/loss is a simple mean of the first 14 daily changes, subsequent averages use (prev*(13)+new)/14.
assumptions.reason: Matches backtrader's own default RSI convention; the spec does not specify the smoothing method.

assumptions.choice: No day is tradable until 15 daily closes (14 changes) have been observed, since RSI(14) is undefined before then.
assumptions.reason: Natural minimum lookback of the indicator itself, not an added filter.

assumptions.choice: SMA(20) is computed on the 5-minute bars (20 x 5-minute periods), not a daily SMA.
assumptions.reason: The spec ties both the SMA and the crossover entry/exit explicitly to 'the 5-minute timeframe'.

assumptions.choice: Session close treated as 16:00 (bars are start-timestamped 09:30-15:55); forced exit triggers at bar time >= 15:45.
assumptions.reason: '15 minutes before session close' requires assuming the labeling convention of the 5-minute bars; start-timestamping implies the last bar (15:55) covers 15:55-16:00.

assumptions.choice: '5% of capital' interpreted as 5% of current portfolio value (broker.getvalue()) at signal time, converted to a whole number of shares via floor division by the signal bar's close price.
assumptions.reason: Spec does not specify whether capital is fixed initial cash or current equity, or how to handle fractional shares; this is the standard dynamic-sizing reading.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit are checked each bar against the bar's Close price relative to the actual filled entry price, and executed via self.close() (market order) rather than resting broker Stop/Limit orders.
assumptions.reason: Keeps all exit conditions (crossunder, forced time, stop, target) on a consistent Close-based, single-pending-order model and avoids inventing OCO order-linkage behavior the spec does not describe.

assumptions.choice: Once flat (after any exit), a new long may be opened again later the same tradable day if price re-crosses above SMA(20).
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'maximum one position' (no pyramiding), not one trade per day; canonical default permits re-entry after a flat exit.
